spectators.label: Cheer-squad captain
spectators.look: stern high-school cheer-squad captain with slicked black hair and fierce eyebrows; ankle-length black high-collar school coat with long tails and gold buttons, white gloves, a long white headband with trailing ends, black pants, wooden geta
spectators.idle: hands clasped behind his back, chin raised proudly
spectators.cheer: arms snapped stiffly out to the sides, shouting at full voice
spectators.shocked: rigid with shock, headband ends drooping

spectators.label: Cheer-squad flag bearer
spectators.look: earnest shaved-head schoolboy in a black high-collar school coat and a white headband; black pants, white sneakers, holding a short sturdy pole with a compact crimson flag bearing a plain white star emblem
spectators.idle: holding the flag pole upright with both hands
spectators.cheer: swinging the crimson flag in a wide arc
spectators.shocked: flag pole leaning over, eyes popping

spectators.label: Cheer-squad drummer
spectators.look: stocky schoolboy drummer with spiky brown hair and a red headband; black school coat with the sleeves rolled up, a small red-and-wood taiko drum hanging from a neck strap, two wooden drumsticks

spectators.label: Cheerleader with red pompoms
spectators.look: bubbly cheerleader with a high auburn ponytail tied with a white ribbon; long-sleeved red-and-white cheer uniform top, red pleated skirt over white shorts, white sneakers, fluffy red pompoms
spectators.idle: pompoms on her hips, big smile
spectators.cheer: jumping with both pompoms thrust high

spectators.label: Cheerleader with megaphone
spectators.look: small loud cheerleader with short sky-blue twin tails; blue-and-gold cheer uniform with a gold pleated skirt over shorts, white sneakers, a white cone megaphone in one hand and a single gold pompom in the other
spectators.idle: megaphone held at her side, bouncing on her heels
spectators.cheer: shouting into the megaphone, pompom raised

spectators.label: Bookworm girl
spectators.look: quiet bookworm girl with thick round glasses and a long black braid over one shoulder; navy sailor uniform with a red ribbon, navy pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, hugging a stack of thick books
spectators.idle: reading the top book, glancing at the ring

spectators.label: Class president
spectators.look: uptight class president with neatly parted dark-green hair and square glasses; navy blazer school uniform with a striped tie, gray slacks, a plain red armband on one sleeve, a clipboard
spectators.idle: pushing up his glasses, clipboard against his chest

spectators.label: Hungry student with yakisoba bread
spectators.look: laid-back schoolboy with spiky light-brown hair; black school coat unbuttoned over a yellow tee, black pants, scuffed sneakers, a yakisoba-stuffed bread roll in one hand and a milk carton in the other
spectators.idle: chewing a big bite of the bread roll
spectators.cheer: bread roll and milk raised in both hands
spectators.shocked: noodles hanging from his gaping mouth

spectators.label: Art-club girl
spectators.look: dreamy art-club girl with a messy lavender bob under a mustard beret and a paintbrush behind her ear; oversized paint-stained beige cardigan over a sailor uniform, a sketchbook and pencil
spectators.idle: sketching the fighters in her sketchbook
spectators.cheer: holding up the sketchbook showing a doodled star

spectators.label: First-grader with school backpack
spectators.look: small wide-eyed schoolboy with a round yellow safety hat; white short-sleeved shirt, navy shorts, white socks, a big glossy black boxy school backpack on his back
spectators.idle: holding the backpack straps, staring in awe
spectators.shocked: hands on his cheeks, mouth wide

spectators.label: Kindergartener with balloon
spectators.look: tiny kindergarten girl with short black pigtails and a round yellow bucket hat; light-blue smock over a white shirt, red shoes, holding the string of a red balloon
spectators.idle: holding the balloon string, watching quietly
spectators.shocked: letting go of the balloon, mouth open

spectators.label: Science-club boy
spectators.look: small science-club boy with frizzy white-blond hair and swirly thick glasses; white lab coat too big for him over a school blazer, black shorts, a glass beaker of bubbling green liquid
spectators.idle: swirling the beaker, studying the fighters
spectators.cheer: beaker raised high like a toast
spectators.shocked: beaker foaming over, hair frizzed straight up

spectators.label: Cool transfer student
spectators.look: tall aloof transfer student with long silver hair tied low and bangs covering one eye; gray blazer uniform worn draped over his shoulders, white shirt, loose red tie, black headphones around his neck
spectators.cheer: one fist raised calmly, small smile
spectators.shocked: headphones slipping off, visible eye wide

spectators.label: Marching-band trumpeter
spectators.look: marching-band girl with a short brown bob under a tall white shako hat with a red plume; red band jacket with gold braid and white sash, white pants, a shiny brass trumpet
spectators.cheer: blasting the trumpet toward the sky

spectators.label: Middle-schooler with foam finger
spectators.look: peppy middle-school girl with dark hair in twin buns; pastel orange school tracksuit with white stripes, white sneakers, a big blank green foam finger on one hand
spectators.idle: bouncing, foam finger at her side
spectators.shocked: foam finger bent over, eyes huge
